_about: Extracted from each Codex session log (~/.codex/sessions/2026/11/11/rollout-*.jsonl): every image_gen call Codex made for one gh303-art render, in order, with the prompt Codex itself wrote for the tool (Codex rewrites the prompt it is given, so these are NOT the registry text). picked = the call whose output sha256 equals the file Codex saved to the requested path, which is the file copied byte-identical to images/. transparent_background_arg is read from the tool-call source Codex wrote; transparentBackground_result from the completed item.
